title: FokasNets: Completing missing boundary data in Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Operators via the Global Relation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33549v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce FokasNets, a framework that combines Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and operators (PINOs) with the Global Relation (GR) formulation of the Fokas method (also referred to as the Unified Transform), for mixed boundary problems. The general framework considers lifted representations of the neural network models, where the Dirichlet boundary conditions are imposed by construction and the neural network learns the interior correction. The Global Relation is used as an additional solve during training that provides the missing boundary conditions to the lifted neural network, making training more efficient and accurate in the interior and on the boundary. We develop the construction of FokasNets for elliptic and evolution PDEs (Fokas-PINNs), and the corresponding PDE solution operator problems (Fokas Operator Networks - FONets), using the Global Relation formulations for these PDE classes. translated_title: FokasNets：借助全局关系补全物理信息神经网络与算子中缺失的边界数据
translated_abstract: 我们提出了FokasNets，这是一个将物理信息神经网络（PINNs）与物理信息算子（PINOs）同Fokas方法（也称为统一变换）的全局关系（GR）公式相结合的框架，用于处理混合边界问题。该通用框架采用神经网络模型的提升表示，其中Dirichlet边界条件通过构造方式直接施加，而由神经网络学习内部修正量。全局关系在训练过程中被用作一个额外的求解步骤，为提升的神经网络提供缺失的边界条件，从而使训练在区域内部和边界上都更加高效和准确。我们针对椭圆型和演化型偏微分方程构建了FokasNets（Fokas-PINNs），并利用这些偏微分方程类别的全局关系公式，构建了相应的偏微分方程解算子模型（Fokas算子网络，FONets）。此外，我们开发了……
tldr: FokasNets将PINNs/PINOs与Fokas方法的全局关系相结合，在训练过程中自动补全缺失的边界条件，从而更高效、更准确地求解混合边界问题。
en_tdlr: FokasNets integrates PINNs/PINOs with the Global Relation of the Fokas method to supply missing boundary data during training, enabling more efficient and accurate solutions for mixed boundary problems.
